notes.title: Minor Update 1.2.4
notes.notes:
Thanks for playing and leaving your feedback and bug reports! I hope everyone is enjoying the demo so far.



Fixed a crash that could occur on the music selection screen or at the start of battle while analyzing custom music in the background

Fixed a crash that could occur when returning to the main menu

Fixed a crash when analyzing music files using less common formats such 24-bit audio

Fixed an issue where music would not loop properly when using custom songs with an abrupt ending.

Slightly increased the length of "short" and "medium" length battles. These occur most often at the start of each area.

The malfunction UI in the Bon Donatello boss battle now correctly refers to "Moves" instead of "Abilities"

Moved Docent Hilde, who players could walk behind to skip a battle.

Fixed an issue where the mods screen would auto-select a locked slot when opening it while all slots were full.

Gamepad focus now starts on the correct item ("Shuffle All" rather than the Shuffle header) on the music selection screen

Increased the cooldown of Bon Donatello's Malfunction ability by 6 turns on Easy, 5 on Medium, 3 on Hard, and 1 on Very Hard.

The NPC on the Nor Sentryville Institute ramp is no longer invisible.

Slightly reorganized credits and added a missing PR contributor.

notes.title: Minor Update 1.2.3
notes.notes:
Thanks for playing and leaving your feedback and bug reports! I hope everyone is enjoying the demo so far. 


Fixed a rare crash when calculating gameplay splines.

Fixed a collision issue where the player could jump up to the next floor in the Marion Town Recycling Plant.

Fixed an issue where Plant Worker Duslin could spot and challenge the player even when the player was not up on their level.

Fixed collision issues with rocks and leaf sprouts in Marion Town

Fixed an issue where the player could walk through the large vases in the front of the Nor Sentryville Institute.

The game no longer generates an unnecessary log file in the Saved/SelectorLogs folder in AppData.

notes.title: May Development Update and Midnight 1.1.0 Release
notes.notes:
Thanks everyone for your comments, wishlists, and interest in the game! This month I've been focusing on improving the early areas of the full game as well as working on incorporating all your feedback from Steel Century Groove: Midnight. 

Speaking of Midnight, a new update launched today that has a ton of quality of life improvements, upgraded animations, more accurate charts for built-in songs, and much more. Go play it here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2969180/Steel_Century_Groove_Midnight/

As for the full game, there will be some more announcements soon, but in the meantime, here's a few new screenshots!

This is your rival Gigi. She hates you but secretly loves you:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45308260/458d7e70e7c3613c2237bb7781347c3bd9751669.jpg

Explore this Tenzerk recycling plant in your hometown. Maybe you can find some new parts here to fix up your broken Tenzerk.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45308260/b6070d58830f33a987d8c7a394493d20fd1ad189.jpg

In this boss battle, you'll have to meet specific conditions to clear malfunctions that prevent your Tenzerk from dancing properly:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45308260/6a6bfb1bf4163871778298f1d78ac6a2d6f3a22e.jpg

If you haven't already make sure to add the game to your wishlist!
